summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing an intimation letter dated July 23, 2026. The letter discloses resolutions approved at the 42nd Annual General Meeting held on that date: re-appointment of Dr. K P Krishnan as an Independent Director for a second term from January 7, 2027 to January 6, 2032; appointment of Mr. Srikanth Velamakanni as an Independent Director for a term from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2031; and appointment of Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as statutory auditors for a five-year term. These are routine governance matters. No price, premium, or deal terms are stated. This filing is not a special situation. Nothing to watch.
